brief.text:
SITUATION NOW
US strikes on Ecuadorian fishing boats raise humanitarian concerns but the Trump administration is not wavering. [1]
US troops are now fighting the drug war on the ground in Ecuador. [3]

WHAT THIS MEANS FOR ECUADOR
The presence of US troops on the ground in Ecuador for the drug war, combined with 29 US OFAC and Canada SEMA sanctions designations linked to Ecuador, indicates a deepening security-focused bilateral relationship. [3][E2]

KEY RISKS
Ecuador is linked to 29 US OFAC and Canada SEMA sanctions designations, exposing it to financial and reputational risks. [E2]

WATCH ITEMS
Whether the humanitarian concerns from US strikes on Ecuadorian fishing boats will lead to a change in US policy. [1]
